meta.title: About Us
meta.description: Learn about AutoMe — the modern platform helping dealerships digitize operations and buyers find their perfect vehicle.

hero.headline: Reimagining the Way Cars Are
hero.subtitle: AutoMe is the modern automotive platform that empowers dealerships with powerful digital tools and helps buyers discover their perfect vehicle — all in one seamless experience.

mission.headline: Making automotive commerce
mission.body1: The traditional car buying experience is broken — fragmented listings, outdated tools, and frustrating back-and-forth. We started AutoMe to change that.
mission.body2: Our platform gives dealerships the digital storefront they deserve, complete with AI-powered features, real-time communications, and actionable analytics. For buyers, we offer a curated, transparent experience that makes finding the right car genuinely enjoyable.

inventory.title: Smart Inventory Management
inventory.description: AI-generated descriptions, bulk photo uploads, and intelligent categorization make listing cars effortless.

messaging.title: Built-in Messaging
messaging.description: Real-time chat between dealers and buyers eliminates phone tag and keeps conversations organized.

analytics.title: Analytics Dashboard
analytics.description: Track views, leads, and conversions with detailed analytics that help dealerships make data-driven decisions.

multiLocation.title: Multi-location Support
multiLocation.description: Manage multiple dealership locations from a single dashboard with role-based team access.

values.heading: What We Stand For
values.subtitle: Our values guide every decision we make, from the features we build to the partnerships we form.

trust.title: Trust & Transparency
trust.description: We believe car buying should be straightforward. Every listing is verified, every price is honest, and every interaction is built on trust.

innovation.title: Innovation First
innovation.description: From AI-powered descriptions to real-time messaging, we leverage cutting-edge technology to make the automotive experience smarter.

community.title: Community Driven
community.description: We’re building more than a platform — we’re creating a community where dealerships and buyers connect meaningfully.

customer.title: Customer Obsessed
customer.description: Every feature we build starts with a simple question: does this make life better for our users? If not, we go back to the drawing board.

cta.heading: Ready to Get Started?
cta.body: Whether you’re a dealership looking to go digital or a buyer searching for the perfect ride, AutoMe has you covered.
